_note: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. The schema deliberately mirrors real marine protected area layers (Natura 2000 marine / WDPA) and officially published seasonal closures, so that swapping in real data only requires reimplementing src/data.py.

config._threshold_note: Legal basis: Article 10(1), Council Regulation (EC) No 1224/2009, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2023/2842 — a Union fishing vessel exceeding 15 m length overall must be fitted with and maintain in operation an AIS. 'Exceeding' is strict: a vessel of exactly 15.0 m is not covered. This is the single most important number in the system: it decides for whom darkness is never an indicator. Set per jurisdiction.
config.ais_legal_basis: Article 10(1), Council Regulation (EC) No 1224/2009, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2023/2842
config.lawful_dark_derogation: Article 10(2), Council Regulation (EC) No 1224/2009, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2023/2842: the master of a Union fishing vessel may switch off the AIS in exceptional circumstances where the safety or security of the crew is imminently at risk, and must notify the switch-off and its reason to the competent authorities. A dark vessel may therefore be lawfully dark; the verifiable cross-check is whether a switch-off notification was filed for the time window. Exact paragraph numbering to be confirmed against the consolidated text.
config._length_sigma_note: 1-sigma uncertainty of the radar length estimate, in metres. PLACEHOLDER — pending calibration against Paolo et al. 2024. The legal threshold sits near the sensor's detection floor, so AIS applicability is three-state: firmly above (length - k*sigma > threshold), near threshold / inconclusive (length + k*sigma > threshold), not applicable (otherwise).
config._vms_note: Since January 2026, fishing vessels of 12 m and over must carry an operational VMS. For a small dark vessel at or above this length, the correct statement is not 'unobservable' but 'absence of AIS is not an indicator; the appropriate cross-check is VMS, which the authority already holds'.
config._score_weights_note: Transparent and configurable. Weights order candidates; they are not probabilities of infringement. Points are only ever awarded alongside a concrete indicator: score > 0 if and only if at least one potential indicator exists. Presence inside a zone does not score by itself.
